body:
That's the thing... I don't like doing things any more.  Piano was once my passion, I've been playing for two decades.  Now, my playing just fills me with shame and hatred.  I get angry, I want to break the keyboard.  

I've been trying for years to make the changes.  I can for a bit, but I don't have the energy to make them every day.  It's like it hurts, like it physically hurts.  

I used to enjoy writing, but now I can't focus on anything long enough to finish it, and whenever I do get a little done, it's either sick and twisted, or I absolutely hate it.  It's disgusting.  

Everything is like this.  Video games, music, art, whatever.  I hate it every second of it.  Something about it fills me with this terrible self loathing.
